data.name: GOLOD
data.detailed_description:
To survive is to win. But at what cost?

In an alternate reality where the Roman Empire has survived to this day, Carthage is in chaos. The protagonist and his colleagues are locked in a skyscraper during a mysterious rebellion - the streets are patrolled by unknown troops, the sky is covered in gray fog, and communication with the outside world is cut off.

There is almost no food. Time is running out. Trust is a luxury.

Every day is a struggle for resources, where even allies can become a threat. Will you wait for help that may not come? Will you try to find salvation in your rationality? Or will you decide that survival justifies any actions?

But the worst thing is not even hunger. Something is wrong with this building. Who is this strange old man in the lobby? Why did your skyscraper become the epicenter of events? What is hidden behind the fog? And what was its source?

  • Join the handful of unique characters with clouded pasts in a trilling and heavy survival mystery taking place in the alternate history.

  • Make difficult or sometimes quite whimsical choices that will have an immeasurable impact on the outcome of story. Brace yourself for horrifying revelations!

  • Sharpen your senses with QTE-events scattered across the plot. Keep in mind, the flow of the story is in your hands!

  • Bask in the horror beauty of more than 40 hand-drawn backgrounds while accompanied with a chilling original ambient soundtrack. 

GOLOD is a self-contained adventure that will last you a couple of great evenings. By finishing and achieving all outcomes and endings you will be able to have a grasp on the full story, free of any possible additions or retellings in the future.

Warning! This game contains scenes of physical and moral violence, as well as foul language. Be careful and take care of yourself!

data.short_description: GOLOD is an atmospheric visual novel about survival in the pixel-art style, where you will have to fight not only with a lack of food, but also with panic, suffocating idleness, secrets of the past, betrayal and difficult moral choices in a confined space.
